description: Mycelium webview permissions. The window loads the local Node server (http://127.0.0.1:8787) as a REMOTE origin, so window IPC (notably start-dragging, used to make the header a window-drag strip) must be granted to that origin explicitly — without this, Tauri v2 denies the IPC by default and the drag does nothing. The two opener grants (D-010) let the browser sign-in URL open in the OS default browser: allow-open-url grants the open_url command, allow-default-urls supplies its scope for http/https/mailto/tel only (no file-path opening, no reveal-in-dir).
